attributes.action: New Brexit referendum before another General Election
attributes.additional_details: Immediately following Sir Keir Starmers resignation, opposing party leaders are calling for another General Election. How many more PM'S and GE's are we going to have before facing the root cause of the political problems of the last decade? We need stability in leadership and we need a new Brexit referendum before General Elections or a further procession of Prime Ministers.
attributes.background: There have been 3 general elections and 7 Prime Ministers in the 10 years since the Brexit referendum. In the 10 years prior there were only 2 General Elections and 3 Prime Ministers. Brexit is the biggest destabilising factor in the UK. Hold a new Brexit Referendum before another General Election.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Hold a rejoin EU referendum now" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/768955
